**Teach the machine to see, then to read.** Two acts, one arc. In the vision
act you build convolution by hand in NumPy, train a CNN on Fashion-MNIST, then
do what working practitioners do by default: **fine-tune a pretrained model**
on your own images. In the sequence act you build a char-level **name
generator**, meet RNNs and LSTMs, use **embeddings** for semantic search on
vendored word vectors — and end by watching the generator *fail* on long-range
structure. That failure is the cliffhanger that motivates attention, in M7.
